question: Fund one stage for a hand-written structural invariant (at most one transient, plus the cascade rules, checked exhaustively), run only a bigger background CTL sweep, or park?

options.label: One stage: a hand-written structural invariant (at most one transient) plus the cascade rules, checked exhaustively
options.consequence: Uses the new rsim exhaustive-closure tools, so an escape shows up within minutes. If the invariant closes with 0 halts (every word of at most 14 symbols plus random long words), proof.md follows with it as the invariant. Stop rule: if it still escapes at the end of the stage, park.

options.label: Background CTL sweep only (larger RWL_mod / NG / RNGS parameters), no agent work
options.consequence: Costs only compute: 1-2 processes of at most 6 GB, each re-checked by Coq only if it returns true. The odds are low, because CTL's abstractions are bounded windows and every bounded token window up to k = 10 already contains a halting word.

options.label: Park
options.consequence: The mechanism is understood: the round-2 rules gave exact predictions on all 759,169 exhaustive rule checks. A proof, though, needs a non-local invariant plus a formal treatment of the cascade, which likely takes several stages.

rationale: All 324 halting L4 words have 2-4 transients in combinations the real run never shows (it has at most 2).
That is a global count. It is regular, but neither k-gram windows nor CTL windows can see it.
A small hand-made DFA can carry the count, and the exhaustive checker settles it in one stage.

evidence.text: Fig 5: a word whose 4-grams are all in L4 runs its stale-1 cascade and halts at step 197
Exhaustive L4 to 14 symbols: 1,000,548 concretizations; 248,016 escape and 324 halt. The 759,169 covered by a rule are predicted exactly, yet 14.5% of them leave L4.
Least closed k-gram language over the blank run: it halts at iteration 1 for k = 4, 5, 6, at iteration 3 for k = 8 and at iteration 5 for k = 10 (21,009 10-grams).
CTL62 decider extracted to OCaml (known certificates come out true). 118 native runs on this machine (NG, RWL_mod with block length 3, CPS_LRU): none returned true.

effort_if_yes: One stage (2 h of agent time) with light compute; each rsim closure check takes seconds to minutes. A closed invariant then needs proof.md and a hand-written Coq closure proof: several more stages.
